newsitem.title: USA: Optical Cable August sales reach $4.3 mln.
newsitem.headline: Optical Cable August sales reach $4.3 mln.

text.p: Optical Cable Corp said Tuesday that it had record sales of $4.34 million in August.
The company said business activity was above target for August with accelerating demand for products in all market segments.
Optical Cable also said it had hired an international sales manager for Central and South America, where it sees a large potential for new business.
